subject: Request: Executive approval for one-off sandbox extension and credits — ElevateAI
messages:
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Hayes <oliver@elevateai.com>, Maya Singh <maya@elevateai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Executive approval for one-off sandbox extension and credits — ElevateAI

Hi Oliver / Maya —

Thanks again for the demo last week. ElevateAI's embedding + reranking test looked promising and the engineering team is ready to run our next integration sweep, but they need a longer sandbox window and extra credits to validate throughput under customer-like load.

Quick ask from our side: can we get an executive one-off approval for a 30-day sandbox extension beyond standard PLG limits and a one-time allocation of 50k token-equivalent free credits to cover the integration/testing burst?

Why this makes sense:
- ElevateAI is at an advanced stage in their evaluation (mutual action plan attached) and expects a pilot purchase if the integration meets latency/cost targets.
- Their target annual contract would be ~$225k ARR if pilot converts — this is the likely next step.
- Granting the uplift removes a known blocker (sandbox expiry mid-test) and accelerates time-to-pilot.

Attached: usage summary from the trial so far and the MAP outlining milestones. I recommend a one-time, non-recurring sandbox grant with a contingency: if ElevateAI does not execute a PO for pilot capacity within 60 days of the sandbox extension end, we revert the remaining credit.

Marissa / Laura — looping you both for deal desk / RevOps visibility. If we need CRO sign-off I'll route there — asking for a single email approval to keep momentum.

Thanks,
David
David Kim | Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
david_kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: elevateai_usage_summary_Q2.csv, mutual_action_plan_ElevateAI.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Executive approval for one-off sandbox extension and credits — ElevateAI

David —

Thanks for the context and attachments. ElevateAI is a solid strategic fit and the ARR upside you called out makes sense. Two quick asks before we send an exec note:

1) Can you confirm the exact consumption projection for the 30-day window (ballpark tokens/day)? put the number in the MAP doc if not already.
2) Legal asked that any nonstandard credit grant include a line in the MAP noting "non-refundable, one-time" and the PO milestone condition.

If you can update the MAP, I recommend we route to Rishi for CRO approval with a proposed credit amount and the recoupment clause. I can pre-seed the Deal Desk ticket once Rishi signs off.

Onward —
Marissa
--

Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Executive approval for one-off sandbox extension and credits — ElevateAI

Team —

I reviewed the MAP and the usage summary. Given the revenue signal and the technical blocker, I approve a one-time, non-recurring grant with the following conditions:

1) Credits: Approve 45,000 token-equivalent free credits (one-time).
2) Sandbox extension: Approve a 30-calendar-day extension beyond the standard PLG sandbox period.
3) PO milestone: ElevateAI must execute a PO for at least the pilot committed capacity (minimum $50k) within 60 days of the extension end date; failure to do so will forfeit remaining credits.
4) Security checklist: ElevateAI completes the lightweight security questionnaire (Dev/Infra answers) before we enable the extended sandbox.
5) Deal Desk: Marissa to open a ticket to record the grant and create a manual credit line tied to DL-2026-0891. Finance to handle accounting write-off if credits are fully consumed and no PO is signed.

Rationale: this is a measured concession to remove a gating item and is conditioned to protect revenue. Marissa/Laura — please proceed with the Deal Desk ticket and confirm the credit accounting entry. David — loop in Oliver with the exact dates + checklist items.

Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Chief Revenue Officer
